question: Should the repository accept `actions/setup-node@v7` in the Pages deployment workflow without an exact-head Pages run, or require that path to be exercised first?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but the changed executable action is used in a deployment workflow absent from the PR checks, so acceptance of the residual risk belongs to the workflow owner.

options.title: Require Pages validation
options.body: Exercise the Pages workflow at this head, then merge if setup and deployment complete successfully.

options.title: Accept the narrow risk
options.body: Merge based on the minimal official-action bump and clean unrelated checks without a dedicated Pages run.

options.title: Defer the upgrade
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep v6 until workflow owners are ready to validate v7.

recommendation.title: Require Pages validation
recommendation.body: Exercise the Pages workflow at this head, then merge if setup and deployment complete successfully.
